name: lumen-ai-surface-reference
description: Reference implementation of the Lumen v0.13 AI surface — chat-thread + lane-search + shipment-timeline + quote-builder + agent-approval + command-palette flows. Uses Anthropic Claude via Vercel AI SDK with deterministic mock-stream fallback when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset.

scripts.install:ai-elements: npx ai-elements@latest add conversation message message-response reasoning tool confirmation sources inline-citation prompt-input suggestion actions loader artifact web-preview agent context
